summary: FBS Global Ltd, a Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed green building contractor, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 13, 2026, disclosing that on October 12, 2026 it received Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Staff notification that it regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The closing bid price of its ordinary shares stayed at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days, September 28 to October 9, 2026, closing the April 15, 2026 deficiency and the 180-day period ending October 12, 2026. Compliance followed a 1-for-10 share consolidation announced September 24, 2026. No deal terms apply; shares continue trading as FBGL.
